mapper.sql: id, user_id, facility_id, reservation_date, start_time, end_time, duration, total_price, status, order_no, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, f.name as facility_name FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sports_facility f ON r.facility_id = f.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, f.name as facility_name FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sports_facility f ON r.facility_id = f.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (user_id, facility_id, reservation_date, start_time, end_time, duration, total_price, status, order_no, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{facilityId}, #{reservationDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{duration}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{orderNo}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE reservation_date = CURDATE()

SELECT r.*, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, f.name as facility_name FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sports_facility f ON r.facility_id = f.id WHERE r.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND r.reservation_date = #{date} AND r.status IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY r.start_time ASC

SELECT r.*, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, u.phone as user_phone, f.name as facility_name, f.type as facility_type FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sports_facility f ON r.facility_id = f.id ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, f.name as facility_name FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sports_facility f ON r.facility_id = f.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 2 ORDER BY r.reservation_date DESC, r.start_time DESC

SELECT reservation_date as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM reservation WHERE reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN (0, 1, 2) GROUP BY reservation_date ORDER BY reservation_date ASC

SELECT hour as hour, total_facilities, COALESCE(reserved_count, 0) as reserved_count, ROUND(COALESCE(reserved_count, 0) * 100.0 / total_facilities, 1) as utilization_rate FROM ( SELECT h.hour, COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) as total_facilities, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.facility_id) FROM reservation r WHERE r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status IN (0, 1, 2) AND HOUR(r.start_time) = h.hour ) as reserved_count FROM ( SELECT 8 as hour UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 ) h CROSS JOIN sports_facility f WHERE f.status = 1 GROUP BY h.hour ) t ORDER BY hour ASC

SELECT r.facility_id as facilityId, COUNT(*) as reservationCount FROM reservation r WHERE r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status IN (0, 1, 2) GROUP BY r.facility_id ORDER BY reservationCount DESC
